title: Timestamp heartbeat (heartbeat/1, DEC-0054)
description: A signed timestamp that commits to the revocation delta's head and to the estate revision. A hub signs one at least every 24 hours while it runs (SHOULD hourly) and after every entry and every revision; a machine whose latest heartbeat is more than 72 hours old, or that has not applied up to its head and revision, refuses what arrives from other machines. A device check-in reports its sequence and at (records.heartbeat, DEC-0053). FAC-SEM-083 and the verifier acceptHeartbeat apply.

alg.description: The estate key's algorithm, signed; EdDSA until Fabric records D2, when ES256 joins additively (DEC-0055 item 9). Anything else is unsupported-alg.

estate.description: The estate whose chain this is: the estate record's estate id.

sequence.description: The estate's heartbeat counter: each heartbeat's is above the one before it.

at.description: When the heartbeat was signed (RFC 3339 with an offset); at most 60 s ahead of the verifier's clock.

estateRecord.description: The latest estate-record revision, with its digest so two revisions with one number are told apart: the shape of a check-in's records.estateRecord (DEC-0056), digest required here.

kid.description: The estate key: the kid of a machine's hubKey that the highest estate-record revision the verifier applied certifies (DEC-0055), not revoked there or by an entry applied before.

sig.description: The 64-byte Ed25519 signature (RFC 8032) over the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of the document without sig, base64url without padding.
